dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Oh, are you interested in these things as well?

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: If you're really interested, then read this book first. It's very interesting.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: ...Hmm? Oh— Sorry, I was off in my own world.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: That was Hilichurlian for "Hello there! Have you eaten?"

choices.text: Why does it sound so hostile?

response.speaker: Ella Musk
response.text: Are you questioning my academic credentials!?

response.speaker: Ella Musk
response.text: Hmph... Well, I suppose that's not unusual. Hilichurlian Linguistics is severely underdeveloped as an academic discipline, so I still have a lot of questions regarding the exact meaning of certain words...

response.speaker: Ella Musk
response.text: The biggest gap in Hilichurlian Linguistics is field work. If I had the chance to communicate face to face with a hilichurl, it would shed light on so many burning questions, it's just...

response.speaker: Ella Musk
response.text: *sigh* It's just... It's difficult to find anyone who would ever dare to approach a hilichurl, let alone try to talk to them. If someone could test out my theories on my behalf, that would be great...

choices.text: Why is this the subject of your research?

response.speaker: Ella Musk
response.text: Don't you think that hilichurls are very interesting life-forms?

response.speaker: Ella Musk
response.text: It's a pity that so few people think the same way as I do. At best, you could say that it's just Miss Sucrose who does.

response.speaker: Ella Musk
response.text: But our methodologies differ. What I'm studying is living hilichurls, while she seems more interested in their bones.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: I am Ella Musk, Professor of Hilichurlian Linguistics.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Specifically I specialize in applied grammar for vernacular Hilichurlian.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Nye mita da ye mosi zido!

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Oh — and that means "Goodbye, have a nice trip!"

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Hmm... Speaking of which, might you happen to know how dragons interact with one another?

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Ugh, my curiosity's getting the better of me again, but what does the dragon language sound like? Do dragons sing songs and write essays?

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Admittedly, I have never seen a dragon other than Dvalin. If only I could find a research subject...
